already_sent.action: Create a new one instead of resending.
already_sent.when: The message or request was already sent.

concurrency_exceeded.when: The environment has as many jobs in flight as its plan allows.

consent_required.when: The call needs the person's consent and purpose fields.

delivery_not_found.when: No delivery with this id exists for this webhook endpoint.

document_not_recognised.action: Send a clearer scan or the right document; try ocr/text to see what is read.
document_not_recognised.when: No text could be read from the document, or it is not the kind of document the operation expects.

environment_mismatch.action: Use objects created with a key of the same environment.
environment_mismatch.when: The request references an object from the other environment (a test file with a live key, for example).

file_corrupt.action: Check the file opens locally and upload it again.
file_corrupt.when: The file could not be read as its type (a damaged PDF or image).

file_not_found.action: Upload the file again; files are kept for the environment's retention.
file_not_found.when: No file with this id exists in this org and environment, it expired, or it has no content yet.

file_rejected.action: Do not retry the file; contact support if you think this is wrong.
file_rejected.when: The file was rejected by a content check (malware scanning).

file_too_large.action: Compress or split the file, or upload it and pass file_id.
file_too_large.when: The file is larger than the environment allows (50 MB live, 5 MB test; 5 MB for file_base64).

file_url_forbidden.action: Use a public https URL, or upload the file.
file_url_forbidden.when: file_url is not a public https URL (private, loopback, link-local or metadata addresses, credentials in the URL, or more than 3 redirects).

file_url_unreachable.action: Check the URL is public and answers quickly, or upload the file.
file_url_unreachable.when: file_url could not be fetched (no answer, an error status, or a timeout after 10 s).

idempotency_in_progress.action: Wait and retry with the same key; you will get the first request's answer.
idempotency_in_progress.when: A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running.

idempotency_key_reused.action: Use a new key for a new request.
idempotency_key_reused.when: The Idempotency-Key was used within 24 hours for a different request.

internal_error.action: Retry later; quote request_id to support if it persists.
internal_error.when: A fault in Lowco; it is recorded with request_id and alerts the team.

invalid_identifier.when: An identifier (PAN, GSTIN, IFSC, …) fails its format or checksum.

invalid_json.action: Send a JSON object with Content-Type: application/json, or a multipart form.
invalid_json.when: The body is not a JSON object (or an options field in multipart is not JSON).

invalid_key.action: Copy the key again from the console; check you are not mixing orgs.
invalid_key.when: The key is unknown, malformed, or belongs to another org.

invalid_param.action: Fix the value named in param; the message says what is allowed.
invalid_param.when: A parameter is malformed, out of range or not an option of this operation; param names it.

invalid_password.when: The password does not open the PDF.

invalid_state.action: Read the object's status first; the message says why.
invalid_state.when: The object cannot make this transition (cancelling a finished job, retrying a pending delivery).

ip_not_allowed.action: Call from an allowed address, or update the key's allowed_ips.
ip_not_allowed.when: The calling IP is outside the key's allow-list.

job_not_found.action: Check the id and the environment of the key.
job_not_found.when: No job with this id exists in this org and environment (or it expired).

key_expired.action: Use the new key from the rotation, or create a key.
key_expired.when: The key passed its expiry, or the old key's overlap window after a rotation ended.

key_not_found.action: Create the key in the console's API keys page, or check the key id and the organisation.
key_not_found.when: The key has no Lowco API binding, or (key sync) no such key exists in this organisation.

key_revoked.action: Create a new key in the console.

message_not_found.action: Check the id and the environment of the key.
message_not_found.when: No message, sender, suppression or OTP with this id exists in this environment.

method_not_allowed.action: Use the method the API reference shows.
method_not_allowed.when: The route exists, but not for this HTTP method.

missing_key.when: No API key or user token reached the API.

missing_param.action: Add the parameter named in param.
missing_param.when: A required parameter or input is missing; param names it.

operation_retired.action: Move to the successor the message names; deprecations are announced in the changelog six months ahead.
operation_retired.when: The operation passed its Sunset date.

payment_method_required.action: Add a payment method, or use a test key.
payment_method_required.when: A live call that needs a payment method on file was made from an org without one.

provider_error.when: A provider failed after retries; retryable says whether retrying is worthwhile.

provider_unavailable.when: No healthy provider (or operation service) is available for the capability right now.

quota_exceeded.action: Raise the spend guard in settings, upgrade the plan, or wait for the next period.
quota_exceeded.when: The plan's cap for this meter is reached, or the environment's monthly credit cap (spend guard) would be passed.

rate_limited.action: Back off for Retry-After seconds; spread calls or ask for a higher limit.
rate_limited.when: The key made more requests than its per-minute limit (600 live, 60 test); Retry-After says when to try again.

request_not_found.action: Check the id and the environment of the key.
request_not_found.when: No signing or verification request with this id exists in this environment.

route_not_found.action: Check the method and path against the API reference.

schema_invalid.action: Simplify the schema; the message names the part at fault.
schema_invalid.when: The JSON Schema sent to docai/extract is invalid or over the limits (root object, 50 properties, depth 3, local $ref only).

scope_missing.action: Add the scope to the key, or use a key that has it.
scope_missing.when: The key's scopes do not include this operation; param names the scope.

service_unavailable.when: The service is shedding load or a dependency is down.

suppressed.action: Do not send to this recipient.
suppressed.when: The recipient is on the suppression list.

template_not_approved.action: Wait for approval or use an approved template.
template_not_approved.when: The message template is not approved.

template_not_found.when: No render template (or version), signing template or message template with this id exists in this environment.

timeout.action: Retry with ?mode=async to run it as a job.
timeout.when: An operation exceeded its deadline and could not be promoted to a job.

token_expired.action: Sign in again, or ask the API for a fresh link (GET /v1/files/{id}/content).
token_expired.when: The console user's token, or a signed download link, has expired.

too_many_files.when: More files than the operation takes.

too_many_pages.action: Split the document, select pages, or use a live key.

unsupported_option.action: Use one of the values the message lists.
unsupported_option.when: The option exists but this value is not available yet (for example format webp on pdf/to-images).

validation_failed.when: The request is well formed but its content cannot be processed; details[] lists each failing item.

webhook_not_found.when: No webhook endpoint with this id exists in this environment.
